parts.name: Cover
parts.Basic_description: This is the cover of a trash can, made of durable plastic. It is a flat or slightly sloped panel that fits on top of the container.
parts.Functional_description: The cover prevents odors from escaping and keeps trash contained. It can be lifted or flipped open to allow waste disposal.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or lift open around a hinge or pivot point, depending on the design.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main container body of the trash can, made of plastic. It is a rectangular box that holds the waste.
parts.Functional_description: The container stores the trash and supports the cover. It may have handles for carrying or emptying.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during normal use but can be lifted or tilted when emptying the trash.
